digest.component_or_area: external integration workflow and Jira live test canary
propositions: The external-integration workflow runs only on workflow_dispatch and does not provide JIRA_* secrets or install the acli binary, causing all Jira live tests to skip silently with no integration signal or CI failure.

Live Jira tests (test_link_sync_roundtrip_live, test_reconcile_live, test_verified_fake_contract_live, test_link_sync_live) gate on _live_jira_ready() which checks both Jira credentials and shutil.which('acli'), both unavailable in the current CI environment.

The external-integration workflow must declare an on.schedule trigger (cron '0 6 * * 1') and mirror reconcile-bridge.yml's Jira environment setup (vars for URL/USER/PROJECT, secrets for API_TOKEN) plus acli cache, download-verify-install, and PATH/auth steps.

A fail-on-all-skip canary must detect when one or more jira_live tests are collected but zero execute (all skip), failing the session under REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1 to surface missing Jira infrastructure as a CI failure.

The jira_live marker must be auto-applied via pytest_collection_modifyitems to any module defining _live_jira_ready, requiring no per-file edits and remaining self-maintaining as new Jira live tests are added.
